title: Training Note: Kept-Arrangement Supplement on Year-End Security Deposits Interest
content:
The December 31 accrual on a cash Security Deposits deposit carries a kept-arrangement supplement that rewards a payment arrangement the member saw through on the account the deposit secures, as shown in the member's Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) records.

## The rule

An arrangement completed less than twelve whole months before the accrual is posted earns the recent kept-arrangement supplement of **0.05** percentage points; one completed at least twelve but fewer than twenty-four whole months before it earns the older kept-arrangement supplement of **0.02** percentage points; otherwise none. The supplement is added to the commission rate of the December 31 accrual, in percentage points.

## Questions answered

**Which arrangement is read?** A payment arrangement on the service account the deposit secures whose status is completed, dated by the date it ended.

**The member completed an arrangement on that account eight months before the accrual is posted.**
0.05.

**It was completed eighteen months before.**
0.02.

**It was completed thirty months before, or the arrangement on that account was defaulted or terminated rather than completed.**
None.

**An arrangement was completed on a different service account of the member.**
It is not read; only the account the deposit secures counts.

| Whole months from the arrangement's completion to the posting of the accrual | Supplement |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 0.05 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.02 |
| 24 or more, or no completed arrangement on the account | none |
